label: Ngā Poutama Matawhenua online wānanga begin
summary: LINZ's 2020/21 annual report dates the start of fortnightly online sessions to October 2020 and describes delivery with Te Kāhui Manu Hōkai and GIS Journey Limited. The programme supports practical Māori GIS mapping and access to spatial data.

sources.label: LINZ, Annual Report 2020/21, “Sharing geospatial knowledge in our community”
LINZ, “Ngā Poutama Matawhenua – Practical Māori GIS Mapping Wānanga”
